title: Generalization error bounds for two-layer neural networks with Lipschitz loss function
summary: We derive generalization error bounds for the training of two-layer neural networks without assuming boundedness of the loss function, using Wasserstein distance estimates on the discrepancy between a probability distribution and its associated empirical measure, together with moment bounds for the associated stochastic gradient method.
